main_text.l: Dallæi argumento occurrens cap. XI. p.131. 132.
tium de istius temporis Hæreticis diserte
Hæc ingenua Viri docti confessio, illius
causæ non parum nocet; Verisimile enim
Siccine officii sui tam negligentes fuêre
Veteres illi Scriptores ut rem adeò me-
lentio præterierint, cùm tot alias res
non sint dedignati? Profectò vix est cre-
dibile; Verùm enimverò ne solo Epistoli-
ci[?] Ignatij testimonio nitatur de istis Hæreticis traditio; scribit Vir doctus Poly-
Polycarpi verba quæ adferi si inspicias,
ri mentionem, nihilque plane dici de
mum non sunt melioris commatis: Nam

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Epistoli-ci" at the line end; the second part "ci" is unclear and is marked [?]. "Vir" in "scribit Vir doctus" may carry an accent (Vír) in print. Printed spellings kept as they are (e.g. "adferi" for "adferre" is not present; the text reads "adferi" as printed, and "Polycarpi verba quæ adferi si inspicias"; "eosdem", "Verùm", "enimverò", "cùm" as printed). The stray marks in the text ("Q:æ" at the start of "Quæ") are printer's marks, not letters. The line "Digitized by Google" at the bottom is the digitiser's watermark and is left out.
